question: After the retry defect is repaired, should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in OTLP endpoint, probe signals, shared telemetry API, and privacy boundary as a supported core diagnostics surface?
rationale: Code review can validate implementation safeguards, but it cannot authorize a permanent telemetry settings, dependency, naming, and privacy contract for the product.

options.title: Adopt bounded diagnostics
options.body: Accept the default-off core telemetry direction after adding an explicit retry path and preserving the documented data boundary.

options.title: Keep conventions only
options.body: Retain approved naming, documentation, and System.Diagnostics helpers while deferring exporter packages, persisted settings, UI, and runtime probes.

options.title: Decline core telemetry
options.body: Keep collector integration outside the companion app until a future maintainer-sponsored observability design exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded diagnostics
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off core telemetry direction after adding an explicit retry path and preserving the documented data boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history most strongly connects him to the diagnostics, Settings, App composition, and tray-test surfaces involved in this product choice.
